batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c AD Mathews b R Sharma

batting.name: R Dravid
batting.dismissal: c LRPL Taylor b Yuvraj Singh

batting.name: STR Binny
batting.dismissal: c MR Marsh b Yuvraj Singh

batting.name: DH Yagnik
batting.dismissal: c TL Suman b R Sharma

batting.name: RV Uthappa
batting.dismissal: c R Dravid b JP Faulkner

batting.name: LRPL Taylor
batting.dismissal: c BJ Hodge b Harmeet Singh

balls.text: short ball that the batsman wants to send over midwicket, doesn't connect well, the ball dribbles along the pitch and Rajasthan end on 145 for 5
full and wide once  more from Bhuvneshwar, Hodge hammers that behind point for four more, Yuvraj dives at backward point but he can't get near that one
powerful hit down the ground, but not powerful enough to beat the man at long-on
length ball and that is powered to midwicket for four, an almighty heave
short of length and outside off, slapped towards cover for a single
good start to the over for Rajasthan, a full ball,very wide from Bhuvneshwar, Hodges reaches out and connects well, sends that past point for four
full ball outside off again to round off an excellent over, the batsman moves across and looks to flick it down the leg side, doesn't connect properly
keeps it full and outside off, thrashed towards sweeper cover for another single
a low full toss just outside off, hacked towards long-on for a single
full and just outside off, the batsman can't get under that one, can only push the ball back towards the bowler
pitched up, and that is again slammed towards long-on
punched towards long-off for a single
another full ball outside off, carved past point for four, Taylor overran that as he tried to field that from sweeper cover
wide and full, looks to power that through the off side, Hodge misses out, he was hoping that would be called a wide, it isn't
looks for the big hit over the off side this time, a thick outside edge sends the ball bouncing away towards third man
way too wide outside off stump, Hodge tries to reach that one but falls over in his attempt
slower one, looks to force that through the off side but Hodge misses
dabbed to gully for a single
rubbish full toss, 'get that out of my sight,' says Faulkner as he pummels that over long-on for six
full ball on the stumps, Hodge can't put it away, mistimes his shot towards long-on
another slower one, defended back towards the bowler by Faulkner, Mathews moves across to his right to stop that
pitched up and that is powered towards sweeper cover
full ball just outside off, Hodge squeezes that towards mid-off
slower offcutter from Mathews, clipped towards midwicket for a couple
full ball on the pads, nudged just behind square leg for a single
terrific spell from Rahul comes to an end, an outside off ball is missed by Hodge

oh dear, one of the strangest shots to get dismissed, he tried a Dilscoop, getting into position really early and waiting for the ball to arrive, doesn't connect properly though and lobs it towards short third man, he falls over as he plays the shot as well
shortish ball spinning away, Hodge deflects that towards backward point for a single
he gets deep in the crease and tucks the ball towards midwicket for a single
well outside off, Yagnik again wants to play that late dab, he misses out
length ball outside off, wristy shot sends the ball towards long-on
works this towards square leg for a single
another four, a reverse-sweep this time, didn't look particularly pretty but he connected well and send that to the point boundary
gets forward and defends this one
length ball outside off, Dishant Yagnik, who has shown he has plenty of confidence, opens the face and plays the ball late, just past the keeper, terrific shot first up

another superb catch, ends Dravid's innings, Dravid got a bit of width, and he looked to power that past cover, played it in the air to the left of Ross Taylor, who moved across and plucked it with one hand, 54 off 48 for Dravid, too slow? or built a platform?
short of length ball just outside off, slapped in front of point, a misfield allows a single
played with soft hands towards point for a quick single
full ball on off stump, Dravid eases that towards sweeper cover, only a single though
punched towards long-off for a single

dropped, it was a tough chance for Mathews, it was the slower offspinner, Hodge was fooled by that one, a leading edge pops back towards the bowler, Mathews has to dives to his right to take that, he gets a hand on it but can't connect
full ball, worked towards midwicket
low full toss, eased towards long-off for a single
eased towards long-on for a single
whips this towards deep square leg for a single
Hodge, the leading run-scorer in T20s, defends his first ball to the off side
backs away and slaps the ball towards long-off for a single

Binny's troubled, and short, stay is over, he was expected to come out and slog, he charges out, Yuvraj lands it short, Binny had to reach out for that one, can't connect it properly and the ball loops to long-on for an easy catch
slanting down the leg side, wide
drives that along the ground towards long-off, the half-century comes up for Dravid, second of the season for him
Binny goes for the sweep, haven't seen many of those yet today, can't place it wide of short fine leg
shortish ball, another boundary ball that but Dravid can only send it to wide long-on for a single
Binny chips the ball towards long-off, just lands short of the fielder there
big shout for lbw, surely an inside-edge there, or else he was a goner, a length ball pitching in line and hitting middle and leg, that hit pad first, that should have been out

terrific catch that by Mathews, Rahane made room and looked to crash that past short cover, it was flying fast and low, Mathews gets quickly down to his right to clasp that and break a big partnership
horrible delivery from Rahul Sharma, Rahul Dravid should have smashed that short one to of the park, he can only send it towards long-on
punched down the ground for a single

a powerful straight drive down the ground, T Suman makes a good stop at long-on, but after stopping it he isn't exactly sure where the ball is, he looks around in desperation before spotting it behind him
looked to force that through the off side but a thick inside-edge sends the ball towards midwicket
pitched up and Dravid looks to thrash that through the leg-side, he connects with that slower one, and sends it to the wide long-on boundary, just lands short of the rope
a yorker on legstump, can't do much with that
slower ball to start from Mathews, turned towards square leg

back of a length ball on off stump, clipped behind square leg for a quick run, this wasn't as well judged as the previous tight runs, a direct hit and Dravid would have been run out there, Dinda missed, Dravid had given up, but he survives
on the pads once more, Dravid looks to nudge it to square leg, off the pads for a leg-bye
length ball on the pads, Dravid places this wonderfully, flicking it away wide of the man at deep square leg
length ball on off stump is blocked back towards the bowler
a quick single to short fine leg
Mitchell Marsh is into the attack, he overpitches and that is powered over mid-off for four, doesn't quite hit it as well as he would have liked, but easily clears mid-off
length ball is twirled towards midwicket for a single
backs away and carves the power towards sweeper cover for a single
again looks to hit the ball towards point, but can't beat the fielder
pitched up this time, Dravid makes a bit of room, slices that off the back foot past point for four
short again, Dravid backs away and cuts towards cover, straight at the fielder
too short from Yuvraj, he gets away with it though, Rahana can only pull that towards long-on for a single
length ball on the pads, nurdled towards square leg
a bit short once more from Rahul Sharma, Rahul Dravid gets back and slaps it towards sweeper cover
full ball on leg stump, driven along the ground for a single to long-on
another dot ball, blocked towards point this time
drops it short this time, ricks back and slaps it towards deep point for a couple, the fifty comes up
spinners doing a decent job here, first ball is pushed towards cover
short of length ball just outside off, defended towards cover
whips a fuller ball towards wide long-on
a graceful drive towards long-off, all along the ground
stretches forward and drives it towards long-off
that keeps a bit low, slides on towards leg stump, stays in the crease and works it to the leg side
pitched up and that is defended off the front foot to the off side, Yuvraj bowling now
Rahane sends the final ball of the over towards extra cover for a quick single
short of length ball outside off, slapped through cover
pitched up and on the pads, clipped towards square leg
drops it a bit short, stays in the crease and defends to the off
pushed towards long-off for a single
Draivd gets forward and defends the first ball of spin in the match, from Rahul Sharma
flicks it away in front of square leg for a single
lovely from Dravid, picking the gap to perfection, the second stunning off drive this over, this time Dravid sends it past cover
back of a length ball, driven towards short cover by Dravid
defended to the leg side for a quick single
that one lifted a lot more than Rahane expected, he's completely taken by surprise, and he is struck on the thumb as he looks to defend, that was 135.7kph from Dinda
classical from Rahane, that was overpitched and outside off, Rahane gets forward and eases that through cover for four, effortless from Rahane, top shot that
thick inside-edge as Dravid looks to drive straight, the ball dribbles towards the leg side
Pune have bowled too many on leg stump, gifting runs really, this one angles in and that is clipped to backward square leg for four
opens the face to guide the ball towards third man for a single
on the pads, Dravid looks to clip that to the leg side again, misses, off the pads for a leg-bye
beautifully done by Dravid, given some width by Mathews, he caresses that past point, no attempt to club the ball, races to the point boundary
Dravid looks to hammer the ball through the off side, but perhaps since he's going so hard at the ball, he can't time it, the ball rolls towards cover
back of length ball outside off, defended towards cover, a tidy over despite the no-ball and the free-hit
on the pads, clipped behind square leg by Dravid
free-hit, pitched up and that is thrashed back past the bowler along the ground for four, Dravid puts some serious effort behind that drive
overstepped, but it was a beautiful delivery from Bhuvesnhwar, moves in and beats the bat outside off
length ball is defended towards cover off the front foot
defended back towards the bowler
length ball that slants in towards off, solidly defended back towards the bowler
length ball outside off, another badly timed shot, the ball rolls towards cover, a single is taken
on the pads, helped down towards fine leg where Bhuvneshwar does well to stop a boundary
lovely from Dravid, brilliantly timed by Dravid, it was a bit overpitched and Dravid leans into that off drive, perfectly finding the gap
back of length ball outside off, mistimes a drive towards cover
Dinda, with the trademark headband and the huge leap before delivering, starts with a full ball outside off, left alone
pitched up and on the pads, easy put away that, eased towards the midwicket boundary for four
moves across to tuck the ball towards square leg for a couple
another lbw shout, but this one was was sliding down so Dravid survives
full ball angling in, Dravid gets forward and pushes towards mid-off, Bhuvneshwar can be a handful with the new ball

fantastic start for Pune, all those Kushal Perera fans get to watch him for just one ball, the first ball pitches on middle and off, moves back a touch and that was going on to hit middle, plumb lbw, golden duck for Perera, he should have been forward to that, stuck in the crease and the ball keeps low
Yuvraj hits it out of the park and the 11-match losing streak is over, it was on the pads and that is effortlessly deposited into the crowd beyond midwicket
full ball is squeezed out to the off side
cracking hit from Yuvraj, Shastri says, "when he hits them, they stay hit,", it was a booming lofted straight drive from Yuvraj, four to go now
length ball on middle stump, defended down the track
length ball outside off, a regal drive sends the ball towards sweeper cover
pitched up again, eased towards mid-on for one more
full again from Cooper, dug out towards long-off for a single
full ball on middle, driven towards extra cover
length ball on the pads, 133.4kph, easy put away, glanced down to fine leg for four
full and wide, Yuvraj looks to guide towards third man and misses
Faulkner gets his wicket, a full ball uproots the middle stump, and ends a match-winning innings from Finch
full ball on the pads, drops it to the left of the bowler for a single
eased towards mid-on for a single
low full toss outside off, punched towards deep extra cover
short of a length, defended off the back foot
down the leg side, tried to flick it to fine leg but he missed out
an appeal for lbw, but that was pitching outside leg
back of length slower ball, 112.8kph, defended towards mid-on for a single
length ball on legstump, Yuvraj helps that along towards deep square leg, a good bit of fielding by Harmeet near the rope
skipping away from the stumps, Trivedi follows him, Finch is cramped up, defends to short midwicket
a single to the off side now
oh beautiful, there's what the fans came to see, Yuvraj Singh's effortless six hitting, that was short of length, disdainfully put away over wide long-on by Yuvraj
short of length ball from Trivedi, 121kph, worked towards the leg side for a single
length ball outside off, driven towards cover by Yuvraj
short and wide, slapped towards sweeper cover for another single
length ball outside off, sent down towards third man for a single
length ball is heaved towards long-on for one more
a yorker on leg stump, Yuvraj squeezes it out towards square leg
a low full toss outside off, should have been put away, finch can only club it along the ground to long-off, Finch angry at missing out
short of length ball on off stump, defended to the off side by Yuvraj
an edge sends the ball towards cover
short of length again, only 115.4kph, still the ball rises, defended behind point
short of length slower ball on the pads, eased in front of square leg for a single, Yuvraj is off the mark
length ball on off stump, an outside edge sends the ball in front of point
short of length ball on off stump, defended towards mid-on, sets off for a quick single, Finch was gone if that hit, he even gave up, but the throw missed, Finch is annoyed with himself
goes for a flat-batted slap towards long-on, badly mistimes it, ball dribbles towards mid-on
Yuvraj not looking comfortable yet, looking to tuck the ball to the leg side, struck on the pads, ball rolls to the off side
wants to help that short one towards fine leg, can't connect properly though
full ball outside off, guides this towards point for a single
length ball on middle stump, defended from the crease
beautiful shot from Finch, overpitched and on off stump, gracefully pushed back past the bowler for four

reward for Harmeet, he continues to flight it, Taylor connects with the slog-sweep but Hodge joins the list of oldies taking astonishing catches by latching on to that at the midwicket boundary, stretches out and jump as he clasps that overhead

Harmeet giving the ball an astonishing amount of air, great to see that he has the confidence to do that even after getting a pasting, Taylor goes for a big shot over the off side, inside-edges it, and the ball bounces to the keeper
wanted to club that one as well, but mistimes it back towards the bowler
too short from Harmeet, Taylor waits on the backfoot and slaps that towards sweeper cover

this time it is on a length and on the pads, Taylor brings out his awesome slog-sweep that made him a crowd favourite in Bangalore in the first few seasons of the IPL, he dispatches that over midwicket for six
Taylor goes for his favourite midwicket swipe but that spins away from him outside off
pitched up, and that drive can't beat the bowler
a full toss on leg stump, easy put away for Finch, sends it over the square leg rope to bring up his half-century
length ball is punched back towards the bowler
guided down to third man, a hint of width, that was enough for the batsman
mistimed drive towards mid-off
a misfield at short cover allows a single, Cooper is back on
chipped towards long-on, this time for a couple, no need for anything rash here from Pune, this game is well in hand
length ball is tapped towards long-on for leisurely single
eased to long-on for a single
finch again skips away from leg stump, looks to power the ball through the off , but he misses, the ball slides between his body and the stumps, great take by the keeper
too short and down the leg side, guided down to fine leg
back of a length ball is defended to backward point
just outside off, squeezed towards deep point, a misfield allows the batsmen to come back for the second
a touch short once more, slapped towards short cover where the substitute Sachin Baby makes a good stop
eases this towards sweeper cover
a touch short, and a bit of width, but Harmeet escapes, Taylor could have hammered that one, but he doesn't beat backward point
gives it some flight, defended to the off side
Harmeet is back, length ball to start, it is defended to the off side
on off stump, chopped towards sweeper cover, pushing hard for the second
length ball on off stump, defended back to the bowler, 'Bowling, bowling,' shouts Yagnik
short of length ball, too wide from Trivedi, Finch carves that behind point for four more, Dravid claps to encourage his bowler, but this match is pretty much over now
guided to short third man this time
short of length ball sliding into the pads, easy for Finch, he takes care to place that wide of short fine leg and picks up another boundary
down the leg side and that's another free run, something Rajasthan can't afford
length ball on offstump, outside edges the ball towards backward point
shortish, slapped towards cover
128.8kph from Faulkner, a short ball that is defended for a single, Taylor gets on his toes to get on top of that one
full ball on the pads, dribbled away for a bye
Finch hasn't looked entirely at ease in this innings, plenty of mis-hits, and missed swipes, here's one more, looking to club the ball to midwicket but doesn't connect
length ball is driven towards short cover
short of length and angling away, guided down to third man for a single
worked towards midwicket, dot ball to end the Powerplay
full ball heading for middle and off, dug out towards mid-on
full and on the pads, defended to the leg side for a single
looks for the big hit and get a thin edge instead, past the stumps and the keeper for four, all going Pune's way here
Cooper's first ball is full, Finch drives it back to the bowler
length ball is driven towards cover to end the over, what a frenetic start to the chase, Rajasthan need a miracle to win this one

what. a. catch. sensational from Dravid, Uthappa was looking to hammer that length ball over the leg side, Dravid was at short midwicket and that ball was travelling, he sticks out his right hand and plucks an astonishing one-handed catch, the reflexes of the 40-year-old doesn't seem to be too bad
a crisp drive towards mid-off, but not enough to beat the fielder there
Finch taking his job of giving a flying start seriously here, he crunches this one length ball over cover for four, it wasn't off the middle of the bat but had enough power on it
length ball outside off. defended towards cover for a quick single
an lbw first up from Faulkner, but that pitched outside leg
short of length and just outside off, guided towards point by Uthappa
short of length ball on off stump, punched down the ground for a single, 134.4kph from Sreesanth
defended to the off side for a single that brings up the 50, within the fourth over! carnage
oh dear, Sreesanth in meltdown here, as he bowls a waist-high full toss on leg stump, Uthappa picks that up and sends it over the square-leg rope for six, that was so close to being a height no-ball

oh dear, Rajasthan are getting a right hammering here, Sreesanth oversteps, and to make it worse Uthappa steps forward and carves that past extra cover for four, this is turning out to be a massive over
a full toss as a yorker goes wrong, whipped down towards fine leg, seemed headed for a four, but Kevon Cooper manages to stop that from reaching the rope
this is more of the Uthappa we say several years ago, he plants his front foot forward and whacks a short of length ball over long-on for a huge six
tapped to short midwicket for a single that ends an expensive over
nearly gone this time, an inside-edge rolls past the stumps, Uthappa wants one, Finch reacts late but he manages to make it

massive! Finch is on a mission here, he's been told to go out there and provide an explosive start to the innings, which Pune have sorely missed, skips down the track and lofts that over long-on for six
fuller and that is driven along the ground towards long-off for a single
short again from Harmeet, this is too easy for Uthappa, can slam it where he wants, picks out midwicket, a flat-batted heave for four
too short, much too short from Harmeet, Uthappa waits for the ball to arrive and then clubs it over midwicket
pitched up and that is launched over long-on for six, super hit that, clean as they come
backs away and looks to hammer the ball through the off side, short of length ball outside off, Finch misses
inside-edge onto the pads and the ball rolls towards the off side, a muted lbw appeal from Sreesanth (not a phrase you hear often)
short of length ball outside off, Finch slaps it to point
full ball that is punched towards mid-on, Uthappa pushes for the single, it is an easy one in the end as Sid Trivedi misfields
a length ball to start from Sreesanth, up against his friend Robin Uthappa, who drives the ball towards mid-on
short of length ball is defended to the right of the bowler, six off the first over
Finch is moving around a lot in the crease, again he is way beyond leg stump, looking for a big hit, he misses and Yagnik breaks the stumps, Finch is in though
first boundary of the innings, gets down on one knee and sweeps that firmly to the square-leg boundary
length ball, Finch backed away from the stumps, a long way from the stumps, and thumped the ball towards cover, couldn't beat cover
down the leg side, and that is a free run
a touch short and that is eased towards mid-on for a single
Rajasthan open with Harmeet, a star of the U-19 World Cup last year, first ball is defended
